pdmx-csv.description: PDMX metadata table (Zenodo 15571083). Verified against the local copy used for every build to date.

pdmx-mxl.description: PDMX MusicXML archive (Zenodo 15571083), 254,035 .mxl files. Byte length is from the 2026-06-02 download log; the archive itself was not retained, so the digest is unrecorded - run 'make lock-mxl' after the first download to pin it.

notes.not_fetched: The Zenodo record also carries ~9.6GB of rendered PDFs and the MIDI set. The converter reads neither, so they are deliberately not locked here.
notes.unpinned_digest: fetch_source.py refuses a source whose sha256 is null rather than downloading it unverified.
